titulo_es: Distinguish data and valuation in a news

축제에는 만 명이 왔어요.es: Diez mil personas asistieron al festival
축제에는 만 명이 왔어요.en: Ten thousand people attended the festival

주민들은 사람이 너무 많았다고 말했어요.es: Los vecinos dijeron que había demasiada gente
주민들은 사람이 너무 많았다고 말했어요.en: The neighbors said there were too many people.

시에서는 내년에 입구를 넓힐 계획이에요.es: La ciudad planea ampliar la entrada el año próximo
시에서는 내년에 입구를 넓힐 계획이에요.en: The city plans to expand the entrance next year

texto: A figure or date can be checked in the text; an assessment like «많다» can reflect the perspective of the writer.
The festival was attended by 10 thousand people. Neighbors said there were too many people.
